Package com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core

Class DriverTimeoutException.NodeDiagnostics

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.DriverTimeoutException.NodeDiagnostics
  • Enclosing class:
    DriverTimeoutException
    public static final class DriverTimeoutException.NodeDiagnostics
extends Object
    Per-node diagnostic snapshot captured at timeout time.

    Fields:

    • getNodeState(): the state of the node (UP, DOWN, etc.) at timeout time.
    • getNodeDistance(): the distance assigned to the node by the load-balancing policy (LOCAL, REMOTE, or IGNORED).
    • getDatacenter(): the datacenter the node belongs to.
    • getChannelInFlight(): requests currently awaiting a response on the specific connection used for this request.
    • getPoolSize(): number of active connections in the pool (DriverTimeoutException.UNAVAILABLE if the pool was already removed).
    • getPoolInFlight(): total in-flight across all connections to this host (DriverTimeoutException.UNAVAILABLE if the pool was already removed).
    • getPoolAvailableIds(): remaining stream IDs available to send new requests; a low value indicates pool contention (DriverTimeoutException.UNAVAILABLE if pool was already removed).
    • getPoolOrphanedIds(): stream IDs from previously timed-out or cancelled requests that cannot be released yet; a high value indicates stale stream ID accumulation (DriverTimeoutException.UNAVAILABLE if pool was already removed).

    Diagnosing failure modes:

    • poolAvailableIds near zero → pool contention; requests queuing inside the driver before reaching the server.
    • poolAvailableIds normal + high channelInFlight → server is slow; requests were sent but not answered within the timeout.
    • High poolOrphanedIds → previous timeouts consumed stream IDs that the driver is still waiting to reclaim.
    • poolSize below expected → pool is degraded; some connections have been lost.
    • nodeState DOWN or FORCED_DOWN → node is known to be unavailable.

        Creates a diagnostic snapshot using pre-computed pool stats. Pass DriverTimeoutException.UNAVAILABLE for pool fields when the pool was not available at timeout time.
        Parameters:
        endPoint - the endpoint of the node.
        nodeState - the state of the node at timeout time.
        nodeDistance - the distance assigned to the node by the load-balancing policy.
        datacenter - the datacenter the node belongs to.
        channelInFlight - in-flight count on the specific channel.
        poolSize - number of active connections in the pool, or DriverTimeoutException.UNAVAILABLE.
        poolInFlight - total in-flight across the pool, or DriverTimeoutException.UNAVAILABLE.
        poolAvailableIds - remaining stream IDs in the pool, or DriverTimeoutException.UNAVAILABLE.
        poolOrphanedIds - orphaned stream IDs in the pool, or DriverTimeoutException.UNAVAILABLE.
